WITH SchoolSAT AS (
    SELECT
        sch.NCESSchool AS nces_school_id,
        sch.School AS school_name,
        sch.GSoffered AS grade_span_offered,
        sch.GSserved AS grade_span_served,
        COALESCE(SUM(st.NumTstTakr), 0) AS total_sat_takers
    FROM schools sch
    LEFT JOIN satscores st ON st.cds LIKE sch.CDSCode || '%'
    WHERE sch.NCESDist = '0613360'
      AND sch.StatusType = 'Operating'
      AND sch.GSserved LIKE '%12%'  -- must serve grade 12
    GROUP BY sch.NCESSchool, sch.School, sch.GSoffered, sch.GSserved
),

-- Parse the lowest grade served by splitting GSserved (assuming it's a string like 'PK-12' or 'KG-12')

GradeOrder AS (
    SELECT 'PK' AS grade_label, 1 AS grade_order UNION ALL
    SELECT 'KG', 2 UNION ALL
    SELECT '01', 3 UNION ALL
    SELECT '02', 4 UNION ALL
    SELECT '03', 5 UNION ALL
    SELECT '04', 6 UNION ALL
    SELECT '05', 7 UNION ALL
    SELECT '06', 8 UNION ALL
    SELECT '07', 9 UNION ALL
    SELECT '08', 10 UNION ALL
    SELECT '09', 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT '10', 12 UNION ALL
    SELECT '11', 13 UNION ALL
    SELECT '12', 14
),

ParsedSchools AS (
    SELECT
        nces_school_id,
        school_name,
        grade_span_offered,
        grade_span_served,
        SUBSTR(grade_span_served, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(grade_span_served, '-') > 0 THEN INSTR(grade_span_served, '-') - 1 ELSE LENGTH(grade_span_served) END) AS lowest_grade
    FROM SchoolSAT
    WHERE total_sat_takers = 0
),

ParsedGrades AS (
    SELECT
        ps.school_name,
        ps.grade_span_offered,
        ps.lowest_grade,
        go.grade_order
    FROM ParsedSchools ps
    JOIN GradeOrder go ON ps.lowest_grade = go.grade_label
),

MinGradeOrder AS (
    SELECT MIN(grade_order) AS earliest_grade_order FROM ParsedGrades
)

SELECT
    pg.school_name,
    pg.grade_span_offered
FROM ParsedGrades pg
JOIN MinGradeOrder mg ON pg.grade_order = mg.earliest_grade_order
ORDER BY pg.school_name;

WITH grade_order AS (
  SELECT 'P' AS grade, 1 AS ord UNION ALL
  SELECT 'K', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 13 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 14
),
state_special_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSoffered, State
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA' AND DOCType = 'State Special'
),
expand_grade AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, State, GSoffered, 
    CASE
      -- Extract first grade code from GSoffered assuming GSoffered is a string of grades covered like "K-12" or "1-12"
      WHEN GSoffered LIKE 'P%' THEN 'P'
      WHEN GSoffered LIKE 'K%' THEN 'K'
      WHEN GSoffered GLOB '[1-9]%' THEN SUBSTR(GSoffered, 1, INSTR(GSoffered || '-', '-') - 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS start_grade_code
  FROM state_special_schools
),
-- Convert start grade code to ordinal for ordering
start_grade_ranked AS (
  SELECT eg.CDSCode, eg.School, eg.State, eg.GSoffered,
    CASE 
      WHEN eg.start_grade_code = 'P' THEN 1
      WHEN eg.start_grade_code = 'K' THEN 2
      WHEN eg.start_grade_code GLOB '[1-9]' THEN CAST(eg.start_grade_code AS INTEGER) + 2
      ELSE 100 -- put any unknown code at end
    END AS start_grade_ord
  FROM expand_grade eg
),
sat_info AS (
  SELECT cds, enroll12, NumTstTakr
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'SCH' AND dname = 'CA'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT sgr.CDSCode, sgr.School, sgr.start_grade_ord, sgr.GSoffered, 
         COALESCE(si.enroll12, 0) AS enroll12,
         COALESCE(si.NumTstTakr, 0) AS NumTstTakr
  FROM start_grade_ranked sgr
  LEFT JOIN sat_info si ON sgr.CDSCode = si.cds
)

SELECT School, 
       GSoffered AS earliest_grade_covered, 
       enroll12 AS k_12_enrollment, 
       NumTstTakr
FROM combined
ORDER BY start_grade_ord DESC, enroll12 DESC, School
LIMIT 1;

WITH SetTypes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets
),
TranslatedSets AS (
  SELECT s.type, s.code
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
),
TranslatedSetCards AS (
  SELECT s.type, COUNT(c.id) AS total_cards
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE s.code IN (SELECT code FROM TranslatedSets)
  GROUP BY s.type
),
CountTranslatedSets AS (
  SELECT type, COUNT(DISTINCT code) AS translated_set_count
  FROM TranslatedSets
  GROUP BY type
)
SELECT
  st.type,
  COALESCE(cts.translated_set_count, 0) AS translated_set_count,
  COALESCE(tsc.total_cards, 0) AS total_cards
FROM SetTypes st
LEFT JOIN CountTranslatedSets cts ON st.type = cts.type
LEFT JOIN TranslatedSetCards tsc ON st.type = tsc.type
ORDER BY st.type ASC;

WITH translated_sets AS (
  SELECT 
    s.type,
    s.code
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  WHERE st.translation IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.type, s.code
), card_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT
  t.type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ts.code) AS sets_with_translated_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(cc.card_count), 0) AS total_cards_in_those_sets
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets) t
LEFT JOIN translated_sets ts ON t.type = ts.type
LEFT JOIN card_counts cc ON ts.code = cc.setCode
GROUP BY t.type
ORDER BY t.type ASC;

WITH AbyssalHorrorFirstSet AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cards c ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
  ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
MostRecentSet AS (
  SELECT code, name, releaseDate
  FROM sets
  ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
RelevantSets AS (
  SELECT * FROM AbyssalHorrorFirstSet
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM MostRecentSet
),
CardCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.code AS set_code,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost <= 3 AND c.manaCost IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_cmc_cards
  FROM cards c
  JOIN RelevantSets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  GROUP BY s.code
)
SELECT 
  s.name AS set_name,
  ROUND(CAST(cc.low_cmc_cards AS FLOAT) / cc.total_cards * 100, 2) AS percentage_low_cmc
FROM RelevantSets s
JOIN CardCounts cc ON s.code = cc.set_code;

    FROM cards c

    WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
    GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.code, s.releaseDate
    ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
MostRecentSet AS (
    SELECT id, name, code, releaseDate
    FROM sets
    ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
TargetSets AS (
    SELECT id, name, code FROM AbyssalHorrorFirstSet
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, name, code FROM MostRecentSet
),
CardStats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id AS set_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mana_3_or_less
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.id IN (SELECT id FROM TargetSets)
    GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT 
    s.name AS set_name,
    ROUND(100.0 * cs.mana_3_or_less / cs.total_cards, 2) AS percent_mana_cost_3_or_less
FROM CardStats cs
JOIN TargetSets s ON cs.set_id = s.id;

FilteredMatches AS (
  SELECT
    M.team_api_id,

        d.A6 AS region,
        c.district_id AS client_home_district_id,
        d.A11 AS average_salary,
        COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
        COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount
    FROM disp dp
    JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.client_id = 3541
),
TransactionsCount AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
AccountBalance AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
RegionClientCount AS (
    SELECT d.A6 AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A6
),
MostPopulousDistrict AS (
    SELECT region, district_name AS most_populous_district_name, inhabitants AS most_populous_inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT d.A6 AS region, d.A5 AS district_name, d.A14 AS inhabitants,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A6 ORDER BY d.A14 DESC) AS population_rank
        FROM district d
    ) WHERE population_rank = 1
),
DistrictPopulationRanks AS (
    SELECT district_id, A6 AS region, A14 AS inhabitants,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A6 ORDER BY A14 DESC) AS pop_rank
    FROM district
)

SELECT
    ca.account_id,
    ca.open_date,
    ca.frequency,
    ca.district_name AS account_district_name,
    ca.region AS account_district_region,
    CASE WHEN ca.district_id = ca.client_home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
    ca.average_salary,
    ca.loan_repayment_status,
    ca.loan_amount,
    COALESCE(tc.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions,
    COALESCE(ab.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ab.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ab.net_balance, 0) AS net_balance,
    rc.num_clients AS num_clients_in_region,
    mpd.most_populous_district_name,
    mpd.most_populous_inhabitants,
    dpr.pop_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM ClientAccounts ca
LEFT JOIN TransactionsCount tc ON ca.account_id = tc.account_id
LEFT JOIN AccountBalance ab ON ca.account_id = ab.account_id
LEFT JOIN RegionClientCount rc ON ca.region = rc.region
LEFT JOIN MostPopulousDistrict mpd ON ca.region = mpd.region
LEFT JOIN DistrictPopulationRanks dpr ON ca.district_id = dpr.district_id
ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, ca.account_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH account_owners AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date,
        c.gender,
        CAST((strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) -
             (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_end_1996
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE a.district_id = 3
),

card_count AS (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),

loan_status_count AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
        MAX(CASE 
                WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 3
                WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 2
                WHEN l.status IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) AS max_status_rank
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),

loan_standing_label AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN num_loans = 0 THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN max_status_rank = 3 THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN max_status_rank = 2 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing
    FROM loan_status_count
),

trans_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('debit', 'cash_withdrawal') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
        MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),

full_data AS (
    SELECT
        ao.account_id,
        ao.opening_date,
        ao.gender,
        ao.age_at_end_1996 AS age,
        COALESCE(cc.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
        COALESCE(ls.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
        COALESCE(ll.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
        COALESCE(ts.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
        COALESCE(ts.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
        COALESCE(ts.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
        COALESCE(ts.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM account_owners ao
    LEFT JOIN card_count cc ON ao.account_id = cc.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_status_count ls ON ao.account_id = ls.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_standing_label ll ON ao.account_id = ll.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON ao.account_id = ts.account_id
),

ranked_data AS (
    SELECT
        fd.*, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fd.peak_balance DESC) AS rank
    FROM full_data fd
)

SELECT account_id, opening_date, gender, age, num_cards, num_loans, loan_standing, trans_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, rank
FROM ranked_data
ORDER BY rank, account_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH non_carc_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT b.bond_type, a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
    AND m.label NOT LIKE '%carcinogen%'
    AND a1.atom_id != a2.atom_id
), carbon_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN element1 = 'C' THEN element2 
             WHEN element2 = 'C' THEN element1
        END AS element
    FROM non_carc_bond_atoms
    WHERE element1 = 'C' OR element2 = 'C'
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS count_bonds
FROM carbon_bonds
WHERE element IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

WITH NonCarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label NOT LIKE '%carcinogenic%'
),
CarbonAtoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'C'
),
EligibleBonds AS (
    SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
    FROM bond b
    JOIN NonCarcinogenicMolecules nm ON b.molecule_id = nm.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
),
CarbonBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN c.atom_id = ca.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END AS other_atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN EligibleBonds eb ON c.bond_id = eb.bond_id
    JOIN CarbonAtoms ca ON c.atom_id = ca.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = ca.atom_id
),
OtherElements AS (
    SELECT a.element
    FROM CarbonBonds cb
    JOIN atom a ON cb.other_atom_id = a.atom_id
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM OtherElements
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

WITH bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, 1, instr(b.bond_id, '-') - 1) AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, instr(b.bond_id, '-') + 1) AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377' AND b.bond_type IN ('single', 'double')
),
bond_info AS (
  SELECT
    bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element1 < element2 THEN element1 || '-' || element2 ELSE element2 || '-' || element1 END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM bond_atoms
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
molecule_carci AS (
  SELECT label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
)
SELECT
  bi.bond_kind_symbol,
  bi.bond_count,
  bi.element_pair_count,
  mc.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_info bi, molecule_carci mc
ORDER BY bi.bond_count DESC, bi.bond_kind_symbol ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH metal_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IN ('Li', 'Be', 'Na', 'Mg', 'Al', 'K', 'Ca', 'Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn', 'Ga', 'Rb', 'Sr', 'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'In', 'Sn', 'Cs', 'Ba', 'La', 'Ce', 'Pr', 'Nd', 'Pm', 'Sm', 'Eu', 'Gd', 'Tb', 'Dy', 'Ho', 'Er', 'Tm', 'Yb', 'Lu', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg', 'Tl', 'Pb', 'Bi', 'Po', 'Fr', 'Ra', 'Ac', 'Th', 'Pa', 'U')
),
single_bonded_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = 'single'
)
SELECT molecule_id
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM metal_atoms)
  AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM single_bonded_molecules)
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH MetalAtoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT element
        FROM atom
        WHERE element NOT IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT element
            FROM atom
            WHERE element NOT GLOB '[A-Z]*' -- to filter elements that are likely metals based on capital letter pattern
        )
    )
),
SingleBondsOnly AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
),
NonCarcinogenic AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label != 'carcinogenic'
)

SELECT molecule_id
FROM NonCarcinogenic
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM MetalAtoms)
AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM SingleBondsOnly)
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH AtomBondType AS (
    SELECT 
        c.atom_id,
        b.bond_type
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
),
AtomBondSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        a.atom_id,
        a.element,
        SUM(CASE WHEN abt.bond_type = 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN abt.bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM atom a
    LEFT JOIN AtomBondType abt ON a.atom_id = abt.atom_id
    GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT 
    element AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(atom_id) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM AtomBondSummary
WHERE single_bonds > 0 AND multiple_bonds = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element_symbol;

WITH MoleculeAtoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id, element, molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
),
BondedAtoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT atom_id AS atom_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM MoleculeAtoms)
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT atom_id2 AS atom_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM MoleculeAtoms)
)
SELECT ma.element, COUNT(DISTINCT ba.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM MoleculeAtoms ma
JOIN BondedAtoms ba ON ma.atom_id = ba.atom_id
GROUP BY ma.element
ORDER BY ma.element ASC;

WITH molecule_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element
  FROM atom
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id
  FROM (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM molecule_atoms) AND atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM molecule_atoms)
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 AS atom_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM molecule_atoms) AND atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM molecule_atoms)
  )
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM molecule_atoms
WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM bonded_atoms)
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;
